description: This file defines the 'LeadsQuickCreate' class, a PHP subclass extending 'QuickCreate', responsible for handling the quick creation form for 'Leads' in SuiteCRM. It includes the process method which sets up the form’s variables, options, and JavaScript for rendering the quick create UI.

classes.name: LeadsQuickCreate
classes.description: A PHP class extending 'QuickCreate' that manages the quick create form for 'Leads' module, including setting up form options and JavaScript actions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Initializes form options, JavaScript, and other variables necessary for rendering the quick create interface for Leads, including handling AJAX overrides.
